detail.title: MK3400 V3 Mechanical Keyboard Red Switch  - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports MK3400 Pro V3 is engineered for gamers, professionals, programmers and creators who demand precision and durability. Smooth and silent Red switches deliver soft, quiet keystrokes ideal for FPS gaming, late-night sessions and fast-paced typing, and are rated for 50 million keystrokes. Dynamic multi-colour RGB backlighting across 12 LED modes adds a vibrant glow to any battlestation, while an ergonomic integrated palm rest reduces wrist fatigue during long sessions. Twenty-six programmable gaming keys with dedicated media controls give quick access to essential shortcuts, and full anti-ghosting with a numeric keypad round out a genuinely complete full-size keyboard for Windows, Mac, Linux and PC use.
